g.text: data/buyers.csv (generated by pipeline/curate_buyers.py, every row reviewed against registry
retirement details) classifies the 167 largest buyer names, which cover the top 160 entries by retired tonnes plus
known subsidiaries of linked groups. Each name gets a group, a type and, where relevant, a Climate TRACE parent:
company (118 names, 94 groups), intermediary (offset providers or carbon tax offset accounts retiring for
clients, e.g. 4AIR, Pangolin, Ecologi, South African COAS accounts), wallet (crypto addresses; tokenized credits),
tokenization (Moss.Earth), anonymous ("Not Disclosed", "Anonymous", blank), unidentified (codes such as "DL",
"GP-2"; not guessed, e.g. "DL" is not assumed to be Delta), public_body.
Several registry spellings map to one group (e.g. DPD Group, DPDgroup, Geopost; Delta Air Lines and the registry
typo "Delta Air Lies"; Volkswagen brands, Audi, Skoda and SEAT under Volkswagen AG).
Registry names are kept as published; the group is shown next to them. Holcim (Australia) is not linked to Holcim
AG because ownership at the time of retirement was not verified.
